TransactionDetails.title: Transaction details
TransactionDetails.notReversible: This type can't be reversed automatically.

OpeningForm.title: Opening Balances
OpeningForm.subtitle: Carry balances over from the old books, once per member or account.
OpeningForm.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can record opening balances.

rules.title: Before you start
rules.once: Each member (per type) or account gets one opening entry. A second one is refused.
rules.fix: To fix a wrong entry, reverse it (members: passbook; accounts: cash book; heads: samiti entries), then record it again.
rules.date: Use the day the old books were closed.

formHints.member: Share, Amanot or Fixed Amanot carried over, one entry per member and type.
formHints.account: Cash in hand or a bank balance, one entry per account.
formHints.head: Land, buildings, FDR, advance rent, funds… one entry per head. Income and expense heads start from zero.

Society.title: Samiti entries
Society.subtitle: Money that isn't a member's: income, expenses, assets and receivables, liabilities, and transfers between the samiti's accounts.
Society.headsHint: Heads and their balances are on the

descriptions.income: Money received: rent, fees, bank profit… It adds to the head and to the account.
descriptions.expense: Money paid out: salary, electricity, audit fee… It adds to the head and leaves the account.
descriptions.asset: Money that turns into something the samiti owns or is owed (land, FDR, হাওলাদ), or comes back from it.
descriptions.liability: Money the samiti must give back later (advance rent), or paying it back.
